'''Hagark''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] who lived during the early months of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Hagark lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], but was captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vischera]] and taken to an [[Vanishing Place|Imperial prison]]. Vischera [[Mutant|changed]] Hagark's genetic code, making the Felucian larger, more violent and fully obedient to the Captain. Vischera oversaw the combat training of Hagark and [[Kargrek]], another similarly altered Felucian, eventually making them his personal bodyguards. When Vischera attacked a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents that had infiltrated the prison, Hagark and Kargrek accompanied him.
